The herdr terminal-multiplexer server BOX (fedora:43 base): the
pinned herdr release binary with a supervised headless server and a
TCP socket bridge on port 8095. Compose this box anywhere a herdr
session should live; host-side `herdr:` check verbs and
`charly herdr --endpoint tcp://host:8095` probe the venue's NDJSON
socket through the bridge.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-supervisord:v2026.240.0121`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-socat:v2026.235.2057`
- `@github.com/opencharly/plugin-herdr/candy/plugin-herdr:v2026.245.1008`
- `herdr`
